title: SOMA: Stack-of-Objects Manipulation using a Quadruped Robot
abstract: arXiv:2610.20968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Executing heavy-duty physical manipulation in unpredictable environments remains a major challenge for quadrupedal robots lacking dedicated manipulators. This paper presents SOMA, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for whole-body non-prehensile manipulation of multi-object stacks using a quadruped robot. Unlike traditional methods restricted to two-dimensional planar pushing, SOMA integrates explicit robot base-height control, unlocking full three-dimensional pushing strategies. This capability enables the quadruped to manipulate complex payload stacks as a unified system while preventing relative sliding or tipping of upper layers. translated_title: SOMA：使用四足机器人进行物体堆叠的操控
translated_abstract: 在不可预测的环境中执行重负载物理操控，对于缺乏专用机械臂的四足机器人而言仍然是一个重大挑战。本文提出了SOMA，一个用于四足机器人对多物体堆叠进行全身非抓取操控的分层强化学习框架。与局限于二维平面推动的传统方法不同，SOMA集成了显式的机器人基座高度控制，解锁了完整的三维推动策略。这一能力使四足机器人能够将复杂的载荷堆叠作为一个统一系统进行操控，同时防止上层物体发生相对滑动或倾倒。该架构将控制分解为两部分：高层操控策略采用简化结构化状态空间序列（S5）编码器对长时间跨度的历史信息进行推理，并通过Beta分布预测有界的目标跟踪指令；低层运动策略则……
tldr: 该论文提出SOMA分层强化学习框架，通过引入显式的机器人基座高度控制解锁三维推动策略，使四足机器人能够以全身非抓取方式将多物体堆叠作为统一系统进行操控，并保持上层物体稳定不滑落、不倾倒。
en_tdlr: SOMA presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that enables quadruped robots to perform whole-body non-prehensile 3D manipulation of multi-object stacks as a unified system by incorporating explicit base-height control into the pushing strategy.
